_comment: Hard numeric limits. The thesis engine may never override these. Any trade violating a rule here is rejected before it reaches the broker, regardless of how strong the thesis reads.
starting_capital_usd_note: Net deposits minus withdrawals, not live equity. Loss limits are measured against this so the risk budget does not shrink exactly when the account is losing. Update by hand only after a deposit or withdrawal.

execution.note: Must be changed from 'dry_run' to 'live' by a human. The agent must never write this value itself and must refuse to place orders while mode is 'dry_run'.

signal.min_articles_note: A sector below this article count gets no model call at all. Thin coverage produced neutral low-conviction theses every time, so the call was spend without signal.
signal.allowed_directions_note: Directions the agent may act on. Bearish theses were measured at a 31 percent hit rate across 5, 10 and 20 trading day horizons on a 99 observation sample, against a bullish hit rate that tracked the underlying. Bearish entries are disabled on that evidence. Set to ["bullish", "bearish"] to re-enable.

loss_limits.note: Measured against starting_capital_usd. A breach halts all new entries for the cycle. Exits, stops and take-profits continue to run: risk reduction is never halted.

stop_loss.note: 'fixed' uses fixed_stop_multiple x credit for every spread. 'volatility_scaled' sets the multiple per position from the short leg implied vol at entry, clamped between min and max. A wider stop is given to a more volatile underlying so ordinary noise does not close a thesis that is still intact.

take_profit.note: Tiered partial exits on percentage of credit captured, not a single all-or-nothing close. Each tier fires once per holding period. Fractions apply to the contracts remaining at that moment.

expiry_guard.note: Gamma risk near expiry is not compensated. Close regardless of thesis.

reentry_lock.note: After any close, the underlying is locked from re-entry. A close at a gain locks briefly to avoid churning the same headline. A close at a loss locks longer: the thesis was wrong and the same news will still be in the feed on the next cycle.

cadence.note: Sector narratives do not turn over in half an hour. A wider interval preserves signal and conserves the metered model budget across a multi-day run.

protections._comment: Time bounded trading locks. Each returns a lock with an expiry and a stated reason rather than a bare boolean, so the log says what stopped trading and until when. Locks halt entries only; exits always continue.

stoploss_guard.note: Counts stop-loss exits in the lookback window. A run of small stop-outs never trips an equity based loss limit, but it is the clearest signal the thesis engine has stopped working.

max_drawdown.note: Peak to trough on the equity curve, not day start to now. Running up three percent and falling back to flat is a three percent drawdown even though the daily loss limit sees nothing.
